PC09-004.name: Always Passionate, Aikatsu!
PC09-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when your "Idol" family Spirit is summoned/[advents]/switched into places, you can draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When summoning your "Idol" family Spirit cards via your effects, the effects of every opposing Spirit/Nexus can't activate.

PC09-005.name: TRAVEL RIBBON
PC09-005.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
When activating your "Appeal"-named effect, by returning this Mirage to the Hand, treat it as having sent the [Soul Core] to the Trash.

[Flash]
During this turn, when your "Idol" family Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can return them to the Hand.

PC09-X02.name: ［Armeria Illuminate Coord］Oozora Akari
PC09-X02.effect:
[team: Luminas]

Flash - (Your Turn)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can switch this card from the Hand with a Cost 4/7 "Oozora Akari" you control in the same condition. When you've done so, put a core from the Void each to every [Luminas] Spirit you control.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) At the end of the battle of your [Luminas] Spirits, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

PC09-X01.name: ［Lilac Illuminate Coord］Hikami Sumire
PC09-X01.effect:
[team: Luminas]

Flash - (Your Turn)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can switch this card from the Hand with a Cost 4/7 "Hikami Sumire" you control in the same condition. When you've done so, by discarding up to three cards from your Hand, draw a card for each card discarded.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your [Luminas] Spirit attacks, send one core from one opposing Spirit to the Trash.

PC09-001.name: ［Magical Green Coord］Ichinose Kaede
PC09-001.effect:
[teams: Tristar STAR ANIS]

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Draw a card, and return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your [Tristar] Spirit attacks, send cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve until one core remains on it.

PC09-003.name: ［Magical Navy Coord］Toudou Yurika
PC09-003.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Yellow-only & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[teams: Tristar STAR ANIS]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
Send one core each from every opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Also, for each [Tristar] Spirit you control, put a core from the Void to your Life. (Max. 3)

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
For each [Tristar] Spirit you control, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Trash.

PC09-002.name: ［Magical Purple Coord］Kanzaki Mizuki
PC09-002.effect:
[teams: Tristar STAR ANIS]

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your "Idol" family Spirit is summoned/[advents], you can put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per step, you can send a core from any opposing Spirts to the Trash. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes.

PC09-X03.name: ［Marguerite Illuminate Coord］Shinjou Hinaki
PC09-X03.effect:
[team: Luminas]

Flash - (Your Turn)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can switch this card from the Hand with a Cost 4/7 "Shinjou Hinaki" you control in the same condition. When you've done so, return two [Luminas] Spirit cards from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your [Luminas] Spirit is not blocked, during that battle, that Spirit becomes Cost 3.
